correctness.rationale: For compact invariant μ with no mass on coordinate planes, cutoff logarithmic generator H_eps′(x)=phi(x²)x/(x²+eps) yields E[r_i|X_i]=0 by dominated convergence, without falsely requiring support bounded away from planes. The circulant matrix with rows (a,b,c),(c,a,b),(b,c,a) has determinant (a+b+c)[a²+b²+c²-ab-bc-ca] >0 when coefficients not all equal; hence E[X_i]=mu/(a+b+c). Writing Q_i=mu-aX_i-r_i gives exact variance and covariance by conditional orthogonality, and summing rates gives r1+r2+r3=3mu-(a+b+c)S, yielding aggregate variance defect. Exact symbolic determinant identity and classical parameter mu=1,a=1,b=11/20,c=3/2 check reproduce 20/61 and 60/61.
residual_risks: The source result excludes all measures charging coordinate planes, including the famous heteroclinic-network measures.

originality.rationale: The main equal-RMS conclusion is directly covered as a special case of the published generalized Lotka–Volterra equilibrium-is-time-average result (Stefano Allesina, §2.4.4, actual full original HTML inspected), and the classical stationary zero-per-capita-growth balance: in variables X_i=x_i², X_i′=2X_i(mu−sum_j Aij Xj), so any fully active stationary measure gives A E[X]=mu*1. The invertible circulant matrix yields the published-style coexistence equilibrium mean, and the advertised covariance/speed defects are the universal conditional expectation Pythagorean identity after the standard one-dimensional stationary generator E[r_i|X_i]=0. Neither cyclic symmetry nor any new dynamical lemma is needed; this specializes a stronger general LV stationarity principle to a textbook 3×3 circulant system. The primary GH literature concerns heteroclinic networks on invariant coordinate planes, which the claim excludes.
residual_risks: The general-LV generator implication is exact without relying on inaccessible source; no specific earlier formal theorem number is claimed.
Residual mathematical question about existence of nontrivial fully active invariant measures is not answered here, weakening independent value.

value.rationale: The equal-RMS law is biologically interpretable but not a new property of recurrent heteroclinic dynamics: it is a direct generalized Lotka–Volterra time-average computation at the coexistence equilibrium. The added fiberwise covariance and variance-speed formulas are generic L² orthogonality upon rewriting the known per-capita drift, with no new sharp nontrivial dynamical boundary. The central GH heteroclinic network is excluded from the theorem by the no-coordinate-plane-mass hypothesis, and no non-equilibrium interior stationary state is constructed or independently characterized. This package is mathematically correct but its proposed invariant is a routine substitution rather than a motivated independent advance.
residual_risks: The general-LV generator implication is exact without relying on inaccessible source; no specific earlier formal theorem number is claimed.
Residual mathematical question about existence of nontrivial fully active invariant measures is not answered here, weakening independent value.

scientific_limitations: The source result excludes all measures charging coordinate planes, including the famous heteroclinic-network measures.
It does not assert existence of a nonconstant fully active compact invariant measure.
Mean locking assumes coefficients not all equal; aggregate sum law does not.
Scientific rejection is substantive generic-LV implication and routine value, not failure to read the original 1983 book in full.
